# Private constructor prefix factories

An owned final class calls two private static descriptor-only helpers before a
protected generic superclass constructor. One actual result supplies its closed
interface-bounded class formal; the other remains an independent interface
context. Frozen direct callers, reflection and method handles observe nulls,
future returned subclasses, float bits, evaluation order, opaque returned
identities, partial construction and exact checked/runtime/Error identity.
Source and SDK layouts compile all emitted Java and compare every original
class/member/Code/access/Signature/Exceptions/parameter record. Qualified wrong
programs and unchanged-Code class Signature controls precede recovery.
